events.title: Enterprise Video Summit 2026
events.admission: Registration closed because the event is at capacity. No on-site registration. Organiser offers an enquiry contact, not guaranteed admission.
events.description: Enterprise media technology, scalable video production, AI storytelling and cloud/IP workflows. Registration 08:30, talks 09:00–17:15, reception until 18:00.
events.topicReason: Enterprise IT, AI, media technology and business communication. A short workplace-design segment does not make this a real-estate conference.
events.evidence: Official agenda explicitly lists Monday 19 October 2026, EDT, at Civic Hall. Official registration page says capacity reached and no on-site registration.

events.title: NAB Show New York 2026 — Post|Production World
events.priceNote: 20 October requires Post|Production World conference pass, standard $799 (student $399). 21–22 October show-floor talks included with show-floor ticket: temporary sale $50 one day or $75 two days through 18 October, then $100/$150. Separate Local TV conference $699 and SMPTE bootcamp are not included in show-floor pass.
events.admission: Paid registration open; final inventory and checkout total not verified. Different passes cover different tracks. No show-floor exhibition on 20 October.
events.description: Media innovation, AI tools, editing, creator economy, streaming, content production and monetisation. One parent programme with actual daily sessions, not three independent conferences.
events.topicReason: AI, media technology, creative production and marketing.
events.evidence: Official 2026 page confirms 20–22 October conferences; schedule-at-a-glance explicitly gives 10:00–17:00 on each date. Post|Production World sessions run 20–21; show-floor theatres run 21–22.
